source.title: House fire rescue: 5/18/26
source.rights: Florida public record (Fla. Stat. ch. 119), released by the agency; Florida agencies cannot claim copyright in public records (Microdecisions, Inc. v. Skinner, 889 So. 2d 871, Fla. 2d DCA 2004). Faces of bystanders are blurred in anything we publish; names of arrested people are not used.

report:
Units responded to a house fire with two people believed to be inside.
A deputy kicked down the front door.
The deputy pulled the female resident to safety.
The deputy rendered aid until Fire Rescue took over.
Firefighters pulled the male occupant from the house.
The deputy entered the house through a back window.
A neighbor handed the deputy a fire extinguisher.
